title: ジャパンCの後に・歪み

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Grass Wonder's chance at victory in the Japan Cup escapes her. But she wastes no time sulking, and strengthens her resolve for what will come.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Now more determined than ever, she zeroes in on the upcoming showdown with Maruzensky at the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Meanwhile, El Condor Pasa leaves the venue in a hurry, almost as if running away from Grass Wonder.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Emotions whirl as the winds grow colder. Winter is on the horizon, but Grass Wonder's classic year is far from over yet…
